original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 8 External Reference Designator string identifies the approved chassis/faceplate-side port, or an approved blank for a record without an external endpoint, and remains bound to the same connector types and port type after reboot. Physical labeling is separate scope.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 8 records, retain the external designator string index/value with handle, internal/external types/designators and port type, compare to the approved external-port metadata map, reboot and repeat without physical connector manipulation.
manual_activity: A user approves the external-port metadata map, blank/alias normalization and reboot plan. No physical label observation is inherent; any requested faceplate audit is separately manual.
required_inputs: Expected external designator per Type 8 record/port
Board/chassis revision and external port map
Rules for blank values when no external connector exists, duplicate labels, case and aliases
Expected internal/external connector types and port type for identity
Validated Type 8 parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not plug/unplug cables, probe ports or modify hardware/firmware.
Preserve raw string index and complete Type 8 context; repeated front/rear labels cannot be judged from isolated grep lines.
Do not treat a blank as a defect when the record legitimately has no external endpoint, and do not treat missing/invalid strings as an approved blank.
Do not claim chassis silk-screen, physical population or reachability correctness from SMBIOS metadata.
Stop on malformed/ambiguous strings, record-map mismatch, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 8 records, resolve external designator strings, map full connector identities and compare metadata before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate ports, substitute a visual check or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the external designator/connector map and blank/alias policy.
Arrange separate faceplate inspection only if required; approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label target is correct, but grep drops handle and internal/external connector/port context, so repeated or blank labels are not attributable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 8 records and compare each external designator string index/value together with both connector types/designators and port type against the chassis map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The External Reference Designator scope, Type 8 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve each external designator string, bind it to full Type 8 record identity and validate the external-port/blank policy and paired connector semantics before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board/chassis revision and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 8 External Reference Designator and connector/port semantics, approved board/chassis port map and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds string-index provenance, external-endpoint blank semantics and complete record identity without asserting physical label correctness.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects misbound external names while allowing documented internal-only records.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: External port map and normalization/blank policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware text may not match physical silk-screen or live port population; those require separate human or hardware evidence.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve external aliases or blank values for internal-only records, but must define the exact Type 8 identity and keep optional faceplate inspection separate from automation classification.
expected_evidence: Approved board/chassis revision, external designator/connector map, blank/normalization rules and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 8 table with handle, raw external string index/value, both designators/types and port type
Record-level external-port mapping and duplicate/blank result
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict; optional faceplate evidence explicitly separate

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets the external designator metadata and does not require physical visual acceptance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The string and full record are safely readable; missing external-port map is readiness input.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw string provenance, full connector identity and blank/external-endpoint policy.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains physical-claim safeguards while correcting metadata capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates optional faceplate inspection and handles internal-only records without forcing PARTIAL.

review_improvement: Avoids false failures on valid internal-only records and prevents repeated external labels from passing without connector identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: With an approved chassis metadata map, string resolution, record mapping and reboot persistence are deterministic software operations.
